compiler.arguments: source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]

evaluator.budget_unit: one explicit source-machine step; a terminal return consumes no further budget

wasm.parameters: live enum ordinals only; erased parameters omitted

output_policy: The compiler opens the requested output only after complete checking and bounded emission; semantic failure and exhaustion leave existing output untouched. File-write failures are HostFailure and may leave an incomplete file, never a Built result. Callers must use the exit status, not file presence, as evidence of a fresh artifact.
external_argument_domain: Each live evaluator ordinal must designate a nullary constructor of its declared type; eval-cli reports HostFailure structured-argument for fielded constructor ordinals. The Node adapter accepts only enum-signatured host calls: live arity and profile-wide 0..255 are checked, while declared signature and per-type domain remain caller preconditions.
later_milestones: GPU reader-safe ownership, task suspension and reclamation (remaining R3/R7)
broader recursion beyond first-parameter field descent

structural_recursion.rule: First checked self-call argument must be a Reference to a strict field descendant of parameter 0; matches propagate descendant levels.
structural_recursion.forward_and_mutual_calls: Unchanged; live forward calls are Invalid check forward-live-call.

structural_terms.patterns: flat constructors with plain or + field binders
structural_terms.observation: Live-field projection, declaration order; erased fields omitted

fields_wasm.arguments: source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]
fields_wasm.budgets: Same defaults and maximum overrides as compiler; profile selection is explicit.
fields_wasm.enum_entry_unchanged: src/compile-cli.bend calls emit, which selects Enum{} and retains enum_profile rejection.
fields_wasm.enum_only_book_bytes: Identical to knot-enum-1; 25 frozen module hashes checked in both compiler lanes.

representation.fielded_type: i32 address of [tag][live fields in declaration order], one 4-byte word each
representation.zero_address: Valid cell address, not a null sentinel

arena.guard: unsigned size > 65536 - bump; only unreachable in the profile
arena.allocation: Arguments saved before allocation; stores after bounded pointer advance
arena.lifetime: Instance lifetime; immutable initialized cells; no free, reset, growth or reclamation

fields_wasm.exports: All original functions, unchanged indices; allocator appended and unexported; no memory or global exports.
fields_wasm.host_precondition: Checked Knot module of selected profile; invoke only enum-only live parameter/result signatures with valid per-type ordinals. Structured functions are for compiled callers. Adapter cannot enforce signature provenance.

host_outcomes.node_startup_failure: Outside adapter classification; not a successful execution

fields_wasm.proof_boundary: Five checked capability/representation/erasure helper laws, not general compiler or memory refinement.

owned_wasm.decision: D10: unique Type plus reference-counted immutable Data
owned_wasm.arguments: source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]
owned_wasm.budgets: Same defaults and maximum overrides as compiler; profile selection is explicit.
owned_wasm.legacy_profiles: knot-enum-1 and knot-fields-wasm-1 retain byte-identical output and unchanged gates.

representation.payload: [tag][live slots], unchanged offsets; one 4-byte word each
representation.prefix: Three words at payload-12: state, count/free-next, layout ID
representation.data: Immutable reference counted incoming roots and edges; repeated edges count separately
representation.pointer_roles: Compile-time descriptors trace only boxed live fields; enums are scalars

ownership.occurrences: Reusable bindings share only while a later use needs the holder; last use moves
ownership.unused: Release unused parameter, let and field holders separately on each branch
ownership.arguments: Each live argument transfers one owner to the callee
ownership.consume: Load live fields; free Type/count-one parent after transfer
ownership.shared_open: Preflight every acquire including duplicate child edges; acquire fields then decrement parent
ownership.reconstruction: Checked field recipe constructs a new parent; metadata recipe is not another root

cleanup.representation: Explicit bounded stack of pointer/cursor frames
cleanup.budget: clean processes at most the supplied frame steps; zero budget preserves all pending work
cleanup.full: Preserve parent and unvisited cursor; raising limit and calling clean resumes
cleanup.last_release: Scan owned child edges before publishing cell on free list

owned_wasm.tail_calls: return_call only when target live arity and complete source local frame are each <=16 slots; wider calls use call due to a pinned Node arm64 baseline-compiler failure.
owned_wasm.host_precondition: Enum-only live argument/result signatures with valid per-type ordinals. Debug memory and structured result holders are privileged, not a public locator ABI.
owned_wasm.failure_scope: Share/shared-open preserve memory on overflow; bounded cleanup preserves unfinished obligations. Whole source invocations do not roll back: discard instance after a trap.

runtime_requirements.R3: Qualified for sequential immutable Data in the current monomorphic Wasm core; GPU shared lifetime remains open
runtime_requirements.R7: Qualified for bounded resumable sequential cleanup and reusable cells; tasks, cancellation, suspended device roots and reader quiescence remain open

owned_wasm.proof_boundary: Semantic model laws, concrete allocator/layout laws and emitted kernel equations; execution differential supplies bounded refinement evidence, not a universal heap/compiler/Wasm theorem.
limits: no cyclic or mutable object edges
no external stale-pointer or restore ABI
